title: Triton Kernels
blurb: Thirty GPU kernel exercises, most of them written block by block in Triton, from a masked elementwise add to FlashAttention, split-K and block-pointer matmuls. Triton kernels are graded on a real GPU in Colab against a PyTorch reference of the same spec, and each explanation covers memory traffic, masking and the bugs that bite in practice.
prereq: You should be at home with PyTorch tensors, shapes and strides; CUDA experience helps but is not required.
next: Take the attention, KV-cache and normalisation kernels into serving with the Inference Engineering course, or compare them with their thread-level versions in the CUDA plan.
